def sha(path: Path) -> str:

def apply(iso: Path, rel: str, old: str, new: str, name: str) -> tuple[str, int]:

    for f, text in originals.items():

    mutated = originals[rel].replace(old, new)

    diff = "".join(difflib.unified_diff(originals[rel].splitlines(keepends=True), mutated.splitlines(keepends=True),
